1. Smooth the colors with the bilateral filter in color mode, the chosen number of times.
2. Round the luma to whole levels and take its 5 by 5 median.
3. Mark the pixels whose median is darker than its local mean by more than the threshold.
4. Paint the marked pixels black and the others with the smoothed colors.
